metadata.description: Dependency & Supply-Chain Hygiene for Java/Maven — scan, risk-score, auto-remediate, and gate dependency PRs.

plugins.name: dependency-supplychain-plugin
plugins.description: Scans Maven pom.xml + SBOMs (OWASP Dependency-Check + Grype), risk-scores dependencies (NVD CVSS), auto-remediates with one consolidated PR, and gates PR merges on tests + CVE + supply-chain. Includes the /depscan-pipeline orchestrator and a GitHub Actions workflow.
